claim_boundary: The pairwise analysis tests a training regularizer and the transformation analysis tests an exact representation-consistency mechanism. Small aggregate changes are reported rather than interpreted as evidence that either component is the main source of Recall gains.

conditions.linear_full: promoted Linear estimator with linked pairwise loss, relation-preserving augmentation, and transformation averaging
conditions.linear_no_averaging: same fitted full Linear estimator without inference-time transformation averaging
conditions.linear_no_pairwise: same Linear features, rows, augmentation, and inference rule with the linked pairwise loss removed
conditions.mlp_full: promoted MLP estimator with linked pairwise loss, relation-preserving augmentation, and transformation averaging
conditions.mlp_no_averaging: same fitted full MLP estimator without inference-time transformation averaging
conditions.mlp_no_pairwise: same MLP architecture, initialization seed, rows, augmentation, and optimizer with the linked pairwise loss removed
